WeakMap object identity cannot serialize or survive fresh import. Node's standard Ed25519 is used specifically because detached cross-process authenticity is required. Core implements no provider and claims no real model execution. Agent owns key custody/real adapters/attestation production; Main owns pinned-policy loading, persistence and verification.
